summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a news release announcing the appointment of Marc Allera and Bill Thomas to its Board of Directors, effective January 1, 2027. No financial terms, stake, price, premium or transaction mechanics are stated. Chair John Manley endorsed both appointees, citing Allera's telecom and network operating experience and Thomas's audit and risk oversight background. These are planned board additions rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure, so no special-situation event arises; no advisor, regulatory clock or deal structure is implicated. Watch only for future governance or strategic developments.
